correctness.rationale: For each residue r=qu+v modulo a=qk, the map from coefficient triples to nonnegative (j,h) with h<=u+jk and j(k+1)+(q-1)h<=N-u-v is bijective. Its cheapest pair (0,0), second costs k+1 or min(q-1,k+1), and monotonicity upon adding a prove all W0,W1. Residue sum/max gives g0,g1,n0,n1 and exact gluing deficit. Independent capped-denumerant dynamic program verifies 110 parameter pairs and residuewise thresholds; finite work is corroborative.
